# GradTensor

> We help people stop fearing AI and start getting ahead with it.

GradTensor is an AI education company that trains students, graduates, working professionals, and corporate teams through live, hands-on courses. Based in India, GradTensor offers live online and onsite training focused on project-driven learning.

## Courses

### AI Agentic Engineering Bootcamp (Flagship)
- Duration: 6 months (4 months live training + 2 months capstone project)
- Live Hours: 64 hours, 3 days a week
- For: Students and working professionals moving to an AI career
- Certification: GradTensor Certification on successful capstone completion
- Students learn AI fundamentals and build real AI agents from scratch, then build and deploy a production AI application as a capstone project
- Contact GradTensor for pricing

### Teen AI Builders - School Programme
- Duration: 12 weeks, 90 minutes per week
- For: School students in Grades 8 to 12, any curriculum board
- No prerequisites: No prior coding or AI experience required
- Students build a fully deployed AI-powered web application (escape room game) from scratch
- Skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AI API Integration, Deployment
- Certification: GradTensor AI Builder Certificate on completion
- Delivery: At your school, online or in-person. Minimum 20 students per batch.
- URL: https://gradtensor.com/teen-ai-builders

### Corporate AI Training
- AI training for teams, customised by function
- Covers AI prompts (speed up daily tasks) and AI workflows (compress multi-step processes)
- Functions: HR, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Legal, CA Firms, Operations, Customer Support, Procurement, Teachers & Educators
- Delivery: Online or onsite, full day or 2-3 live sessions
- URL: https://gradtensor.com/corporate
